The response should not repeat any word more than 4 times. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a medieval king turning his empire's aesthetic into a proto-vaporwaveassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle yet revolutionary change is unfolding.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout and proud monarch, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his loyal advisors. But instead of the traditional regalia, he wears a sleek, pastel-colored jumpsuit, complete with a neon-lit crown.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
My friends, I have a vision. Our empire's aesthetic must evolve. We must tap into the zeitgeist of the future.

ADVISOR 1
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, our empire is built on tradition and honor.

REGINALD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Tradition is for the weak. We must be bold, we must be avant-garde. We must be... vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle's courtyard is transformed into a surreal landscape. Water features, once a symbol of power and control, now resemble a psychedelic dreamscape. Fountains shoot forth a kaleidoscope of colors, while the sound of gentle, distorted synths wafts through the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors are now dressed in their own vaporwave-inspired attire. One advisor sports a bright pink wig, while another wears a suit with a built-in, flashing LED display.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
We must not just adopt this aesthetic, we must own it. We must make it our own.

ADVISOR 2
(excitedly)
But, Your Majesty, what about our enemies? Will they not be intimidated by our... unorthodox approach?

REGINALD
(smirking)
Intimidated? Ha! They will be mesmerized. They will be entranced by our very... vaporwave-ness.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The castle walls, once a symbol of strength and protection, now feature a mesmerizing display of glitch art. Distorted, pixelated images of the kingdom's subjects dance across the stone, creating a hypnotic effect.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors are now gathered around a large, glowing screen. The image of a futuristic, neon-lit cityscape flickers to life, accompanied by a haunting, ambient soundtrack.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
This is our future. This is our empire's aesthetic. Let us embrace the void, and let the void embrace us.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans out, revealing the castle in all its vaporwave glory. The once-majestic structure now seems almost... otherworldly. The future is uncertain, but one thing is clear: King Reginald III's empire will never be the same again.

FADE TO BLACK.
